title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Key Information Memorandum (KIM) & SID

sections.content: The investment objective is to provide long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly (minimum 65%) in equity and equity-related instruments of mid-sized companies. In accordance with SEBI categorization guidelines, mid-cap companies are defined as those ranked 101st to 250th in terms of full market capitalization. Up to 35% may be invested in large cap, small cap, or debt instruments.

Minimum initial investment amount is ₹100 and in multiples of ₹1 thereafter. Minimum Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) installment is ₹100 per month for a minimum of 6 installments. The scheme offers Direct Plan and Regular Plan, with Growth and Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal (IDCW) options.

Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks, including volatility inherent to mid-cap equities. There is no statutory lock-in period for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund as it is an open-ended growth scheme. Units can be redeemed on any business day at prevailing Net Asset Value (NAV).
